# HEM v0.7.4b3 — Settings levels for every HEM menu

- Replaces the Advanced checkbox with a cumulative **Basic / Advanced / Expert** selector in the Home, room and device settings menus. Higher levels include the controls from the lower levels.
- Keeps everyday operation, required setup and source selection, targets, safety protections, recovery and proposal-review actions available at Basic. Manual Kp, Ki and Kd editors move to Advanced. Specialist process-model inputs and custom capacity tuning belong to Expert.
- Remembers the chosen display level for the current Home Assistant user in the browser and applies it across HEM settings menus. The menus also work when browser storage is unavailable.
- Keeps search within the selected level and explains when matching settings exist at a higher level. Empty groups are hidden and visible counts follow the selected level.
- Preserves focused inputs, unsaved edits, pending saves and errors while changing levels or searching. Changing the display level does not save or change controller settings.
- Updates the exact-key settings inventory and adds regression coverage for all three levels, home/room/device menus, preference isolation, search, edits and English, Greek and German layouts.

The calibration interruption and recovery fixes from v0.7.4b2 remain included. PID learning status and approval information remain available while detailed editors follow the selected level.

Update through HACS with beta versions enabled, restart Home Assistant to load the integration, and reload the dashboard to load the updated card.
